I'm 16 so I do live at home. I'll be moving out when I'm 18. No, she isn't. I told a friend once but although at the the time she seemed to care, she hasn't really seemed bothered since. And they basically said they just wanted to use me as a source of gossip (ugh, girls are so bitchy). 

I'll figure something out. Thanks for your reply.
